name: Joanne's Crush
source:
Joanne, a high school girl who struggles to confess her love due to her shyness.

Contains 3 good endings, 4 bad endings and 2 CGs.

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=joannes_crush.myapp]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
乔安是一名高中女生，性格腼腆，因此一直难以向喜欢的人告白。

游戏包含三个好结局、四个坏结局与两张CG。

[改编自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=joannes_crush.myapp]Google Play[/url]]
